'''March 2001 Columbus tournament (17 March)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Silverking Comics, Columbus, Ohio on 17 March 2001. [[Kyle Fisher]] won it. It is known from Brian Sykes's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1931">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-20-what-do-you-mean-its-not-constructedd1931/ what-do-you-mean-its-not-constructed], DeckTech (Brian "Armus" Sykes, 20 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-20-what-do-you-mean-its-not-constructedd1931/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 17 March 2001
* '''Site:''' Silverking Comics, Columbus, Ohio
* '''Format:''' [[Death Star II Closed Environment]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Kyle Fisher]]
